flavor: Ash falls like grey snow from the vaulted ceiling, coating the cracked obsidian floor in a thick, velvet layer. At the center, a single, unquenchable flame dances atop a pedestal of scorched bone, casting long, flickering shadows that seem to writhe against the heat-warped walls.
name: The Cinder-Stained Altar
reason: A place of ritual sacrifice where the heat is so intense it physically drains the stamina of those who linger.
